cards.name: Saheeli, the Gifted
questions: Loyalty costs use the {loyalty: N} cost atom (+N adds counters, -N removes) with sorcery-speed, once-per-turn timing. OK?

'The next spell you cast this turn has affinity for artifacts' has no 'next spell' target, so it is a grant_effect step (appliesTo:'next_spell_cast') plus the scripted marker next_spell_gains_keyword. Should the schema grow a next-spell grant?

'Create a token that's a copy of each artifact you control, haste, exile at the next end step' is repeat_for_each + copy with gainKeywords:['haste'] and exileAt:'next_end_step' (same shape as Goldlust Triad's exileAt). 'Can be your commander' is a scripted marker (can_be_your_commander) the deck loader would read.

cards.name: Archway of Innovation
questions: 'This land enters tapped unless you control an Island' is a would_enter modify tapped with a negated controls condition. 'The next spell you cast this turn has improvise' reuses the next_spell_cast grant shape from Saheeli, the Gifted. OK?

cards.name: Brudiclad, Telchor Engineer
questions: 'Each other token you control becomes a copy of that token' is a copy step with all:true, becomes:true (the objects themselves change, no new tokens) and excludeChosen:true, gated by step_done on the optional choose. OK?

cards.name: Crackle with Power
questions: 'Each of up to X targets': TargetSpec.count.max must be a fixed integer, so it is {min:0,max:1} plus the scripted marker target_count_up_to_X. Should count.max accept a Quantity?

cards.name: Daretti, Scrap Savant
questions: Loyalty costs use the {loyalty: N} cost atom (+N adds counters, -N removes) with sorcery-speed, once-per-turn timing. OK?
Emblems have no step kind. Written as a grant_effect step with emblem:true whose modify.grantAbility carries the emblem's ability. Should the schema get a create_emblem step?
'Discard up to two cards, then draw that many': discard has upTo:true and the draw amount is event_amount (the number actually discarded). OK?

cards.name: Fellwar Stone
questions: 'One mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce' is {anyColor:1} plus the scripted marker mana_colors_an_opponent_land_could_produce (the kernel must restrict the colors). Should ManaSpec get an 'optionsFrom' filter?

cards.name: Finale of Revelation
questions: 'Draw X cards. If X is 10 or more, instead shuffle your graveyard into your library, draw X cards, untap up to five lands, and you have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game' is an if_else (compare X >= 10). The permanent 'no maximum hand size' is a grant_effect with duration 'instant' (= no expiry). 'Exile Finale of Revelation' is its own line and a move_card_zone step on self. OK?

cards.name: Frostboil Snarl
questions: 'Add {U} or {R}': ManaSpec has no 'choose one' form. Written as one mana ability whose produces list has two single-colour entries ({U}, {R}); the convention is that several entries in one ability are alternatives the player chooses from, while a single entry like {U}{R} is all produced together. OK?

'As this land enters, you may reveal an Island or Mountain card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.' is a would_enter 'also' replacement: optional reveal step, then tap self unless the reveal happened (step_done). OK?

cards.name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
questions: 'Historic' (artifacts, legendaries and Sagas, from the reminder text) is written as an anyOf filter on the cast trigger subject. OK?

cards.name: Loyal Apprentice
questions: Lieutenant (an ability word) is just the intervening-if 'you control your commander', written with the filter flag isCommander. OK?

cards.name: Memnarch
questions: 'Lasts indefinitely' is written as no duration on the step (permanent effect). OK?

cards.name: Mimic Vat
questions: Imprint uses the pilot's linkExile / linked_exile pair. 'Return each other card exiled with this artifact' is a move_card_zone on linked_exile with excludeLatest:true (all but the card just exiled). OK?

cards.name: Mirrorworks
questions: 'You may pay {2}. If you do, create a token copy' follows the Mind's Eye shape: optional step + optionalCost + paid_additional_cost condition. OK?

cards.name: Mycosynth Lattice
questions: Line 2 ('all cards that aren't on the battlefield, spells, and permanents are colorless') is a static over zone:'any' with setColors:[] (empty = colorless). OK?

cards.name: Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
questions: 'Becomes a copy of another target artifact or creature until end of turn, except it's an artifact in addition' is a copy step with of:'t2', duration and exceptAddTypes:['Artifact'] (like Cursed Mirror's exceptGrant). OK?

cards.name: Saheeli's Artistry
questions: VALIDATOR BUG: the mode check reads 'Choose one or both' as 'choose one' (regex has no 'one or both' branch) and demands choose 1..1. Workaround: the header line is left out of the ability text (marker choose_one_or_both on the ability) and the bullets are the text with modes.choose 1..2. Fix the validator (one or both = 1..2) and the header can be merged back.

cards.name: Saheeli's Directive
questions: 'Any number of' has no count form: written as anyNumber:true on the choose step. 'Reveal the top X cards' is look_top with reveal:true. OK?
